QF.id: AIFM CIII Modern Portfolio Theory and Capital Market Theory_11

question.text: Mr. Arvind Mehta runs Himalaya Arbitrage Fund. Risk-free rate is 7%, expected market return is 13%, fund beta is 0.8. What is the CAPM required return for the fund?

explanation.text: The Logic: CAPM: E(Ri) = Rf + beta*(Rm - Rf) = 7% + 0.8*(13% - 7%) = 7% + 0.8*6% = 7% + 4.8% = 11.8%. The Trap: (B) 13.4% adds beta*Rm instead of beta*(Rm-Rf). (C) 10.4% uses (Rm-Rf)*0.6. (D) 12.6% double-counts Rf. Note: Workbook pages 64-66 and the Cat III alpha/CAPM example on pages 224-225 set out the CAPM formula E(Ri) = Rf + beta*(Rm - Rf). Apply the formula directly to the inputs given in the stem.
